name: Delhi
popular_for: Heritage, Street Food, Architecture & Markets
description: India's historic capital blends ancient Mughal monuments, vibrant Chandni Chowk bazaars, and modern metropolis culture.
safety_note: Exercise standard precautions in busy market areas and avoid unlit streets after late night.

name: Mumbai
popular_for: Bollywood, Coastal Promenades & Colonial Heritage
description: The City of Dreams offers iconic Marine Drive sunsets, historic Gateway of India, colonial architecture, and energetic nightlife.
safety_note: Mumbai is known as one of India's safest metros; public transport and cabs remain reliable round the clock.

name: Jaipur
popular_for: Palaces, Forts & Royal Rajasthani Culture
description: Step into the Pink City of majestic hilltop forts, ornate pink sandstone palaces, and vibrant artisanal bazaars.
safety_note: Very welcoming tourist hub; negotiate local transport beforehand for smooth travels.

name: Goa
popular_for: Beaches, Nightlife & Portuguese Architecture
description: India's beach paradise offers golden sands, historic Portuguese churches, vibrant night markets, and thrilling water sports.
safety_note: Friendly tourist atmosphere; stick to licensed taxis or rented scooters and well-frequented beach belts.

name: Manali
popular_for: Snow Mountains, Adventure Sports & Pine Valleys
description: A picturesque Himalayan hill station surrounded by pine forests, snow peaks, Solang adventure park, and serene monasteries.
safety_note: Extremely peaceful mountain region; check winter snow conditions before high pass travel.

name: Udaipur
popular_for: Lakes, Marble Palaces & Romantic Sunset Views
description: The City of Lakes boasts shimmering Lake Pichola, marble City Palace, romantic rooftop lakeside dining, and heritage ghats.
safety_note: Serene and hospitable heritage town with excellent safety ratings across tourist areas.

name: Rishikesh
popular_for: Yoga, Ganges Ganga Aarti & White Water Rafting
description: Spiritual haven along the holy Ganges featuring world-famous ashrams, Lakshman Jhula suspension bridges, and thrilling river rafting.
safety_note: Spiritual, calm atmosphere; follow river safety guidelines during water activities.

name: Kochi
popular_for: Chinese Fishing Nets, Colonial Fort Kochi & Spice Markets
description: A historic port city where Portuguese, Dutch, and British colonial influences meet serene Kerala backwaters.
safety_note: High safety standards, friendly locals, and well-regulated tourism transport.

name: Shimla
popular_for: Mall Road, Colonial Architecture & Toy Train
description: The summer capital of British India features the scenic Ridge, bustling Mall Road, pine hills, and Kalka-Shimla toy train.
safety_note: Safe hill destination with active pedestrian zones and helpful local community.

name: Agra
popular_for: Taj Mahal, Mughal Forts & Marble Crafts
description: Home to the world-famous Taj Mahal, magnificent Agra Fort, and rich Mughal architectural heritage along the Yamuna river.
safety_note: Book official guides at monument gates and use government or hotel cabs.

name: Varanasi
popular_for: Ghats, Ganga Aarti & Ancient Spiritual Culture
description: One of the world's oldest continuously inhabited cities, famous for mystical ghats, sunrise Ganges boat rides, and evening Aarti.
safety_note: Crowded narrow lanes; keep belongings secure and hire verified boat captains.

name: Amritsar
popular_for: Golden Temple, Wagah Border & Punjabi Cuisine
description: Spiritual heart of Sikhism housing the revered Golden Temple, historic Jallianwala Bagh, and patriotic Wagah Border ceremony.
safety_note: Extremely safe and hospitable city with deep cultural respect for travellers.

name: Pondicherry
popular_for: French Quarter, Beaches & Auroville Meditation
description: Charming coastal town with mustard-yellow French colonial villas, serene Promenade Beach, and experimental Auroville township.
safety_note: Relaxed seaside vibes; bicycle and scooter rentals are safe and widely used.

name: Coorg (Madikeri)
popular_for: Coffee Plantations, Waterfalls & Misty Hills
description: Known as the Scotland of India, offering rolling coffee estates, Abbey Falls, spice plantations, and elephant camps.
safety_note: Tranquil green sanctuary with hospitable homestays and safe mountain roads.

name: Darjeeling
popular_for: Tea Gardens, Kanchenjunga Views & Himalayan Railway
description: Nestled in the Eastern Himalayas, famous for emerald tea gardens, views of Mt. Kanchenjunga, and UNESCO Toy Train.
safety_note: Gentle mountain culture with high safety for solo and group travellers.

name: Mysore (Mysuru)
popular_for: Royal Palaces, Silk, Sandalwood & Yoga
description: The City of Palaces renowned for illuminated Mysuru Palace, Chamundi Hill temple, royal heritage, and traditional silk weaving.
safety_note: Clean, well-maintained heritage city with excellent safety standards.

name: Hampi
popular_for: Vijayanagara Ruins, Boulder Landscapes & Temples
description: A UNESCO World Heritage site of ancient stone temples, royal pavilion ruins, and surreal boulder-strewn landscapes along Tungabhadra river.
safety_note: Friendly heritage town; carry water and sun protection when exploring ruins.

name: Andaman & Nicobar Islands
popular_for: Radhanagar Beach, Scuba Diving & Coral Reefs
description: Tropical paradise featuring world-rated Radhanagar beach on Havelock Island, crystal turquoise waters, and vibrant coral scuba diving.
safety_note: Exceptionally safe island destination with tourist police and clear ferry regulations.

name: Ladakh (Leh)
popular_for: Pangong Lake, High Mountain Passes & Monasteries
description: High-altitude desert mountain territory of turquoise Pangong Tso lake, Nubra Valley sand dunes, double-hump camels, and ancient monasteries.
safety_note: High altitude requires 24-48 hours acclimatisation in Leh upon arrival; safe and peaceful.

name: Munnar
popular_for: Rolling Tea Gardens, Anamudi Peak & Misty Valleys
description: Famous hill station in the Western Ghats surrounded by endless green tea carpet hills, spice plantations, and rare Nilgiri Tahr.
safety_note: Lush, tranquil hill environment with safe road transport and friendly tea estate hospitality.

name: Ooty (Udhagamandalam)
popular_for: Nilgiri Mountain Railway, Botanical Gardens & Lakes
description: Queen of Nilgiri hill stations featuring eucalyptus forests, Ooty Lake boating, sprawling tea gardens, and UNESCO toy train.
safety_note: Charming, well-policed hill town popular with families and group travellers.

name: Kasol
popular_for: Parvati Valley, Treks & Riverside Cafes
description: Scenic village in Parvati Valley famous for scenic treks to Kheerganga, serene riverside cafes, and Himalayan nature trails.
safety_note: Stick to established trekking trails and hire licensed local guides for mountain hikes.
